method: Sequential config sweep on live workstation; 1 first call + 5 warm runs per isolated case; 3 image requests per coexistence configuration; image service temporary loopback, GPU resident, CUDA backend, VAE tiling, MemoryMax6G/MemorySwapMax0; synthetic audio only. Not a controlled idle-host or statistical significance study.
failures: Original production CPU-offload image baseline at 1024x1024 exhausted host RAM, killing sd-cpp and a Steam helper; no completed baseline timings.
First temporary invocation omitted NVIDIA runtime path, fell back to CPU, and hit its 6GiB cgroup cap. Excluded from timings.
